utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Registrar, kindly call the case, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honours. This is case number IT-04-74-T, the Prosecutor versus Prlic et al. Thank you, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you, registrar. Today we are Monday afternoon. I'd like to greet all the people in the courtroom, representatives of the Prosecution, Defence counsel, the accused, as well as all the people present in this courtroom. Before I give the floor to Mr. Murphy, I would like to give the floor to the registrar so he can give us IC numbers.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour. Several parties have submitted lists of documents to be tendered through Witness E. The list submitted by the OTP shall be given Exhibit number IC 654; the list submitted by 2D shall be given Exhibit number IC 655; the list submitted by 4D shall be given Exhibit number IC 656; the list submitted by 5D shall be given Exhibit number IC 657; and the list submitted by 6D shall be given Exhibit number IC 658. Thank you, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you, registrar. Mr. Murphy, you have the floor.

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: Thank you very much, Your Honour. Good afternoon, Mr. President, Your Honours, everyone in the courtroom. I think we're getting a transcript from a different proceeding, at least I am on my screen. At least on the passive screen we're getting today's but not on our screens. I think I can proceed because we are getting it at least on the official screen. Your Honour, I just wanted to take a moment to formally introduce to the Trial Chamber Mr. Karim Khan, who will be taking over for me as co-counsel for Mr. Stojic in the very near future. Your Honour, Mr. Khan is a member of the English bar, and he has had experience not only at this Tribunal but also at the special courts in Sierra Leone and East Timor, and in addition to many other distinctions is the co-author of Archbold on international courts. So he is a recognised authority on international criminal law, and I think all I need say in that regard is that under Ms. Nozica's leadership we will be continuing, on behalf of the Stojic Defence, to provide the Trial Chamber with a very high level of assistance in all respects. So, Your Honour, I hope everyone will welcome Mr. Khan as they have me into the proceedings.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you, Mr. Murphy. On behalf of my colleagues and Mr. Mindua who will join us in a few moments, I would like to welcome Mr. Khan, who has joined Mr. Stojic's Defence team. We have, of course, acknowledged the fact or acknowledged the resume of this new Defence lawyer, and as soon as I have time I will read the book he wrote on international courts. So welcome, Mr. Khan. I shall now give the floor to Mr. Kovacic, who was on his feet at some point in time.

utterances.speaker: MR. KOVACIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, thank you. Good afternoon to everybody, the Trial Chamber, and everybody else in the courtroom. I just wanted to make a brief request, Your Honours. This morning we received from the Prosecution an addendum to the proposal for protective measures for Witness C who we're going to hear today, and I'd just like to remind you that the Prosecution submitted a written proposal earlier and the Defence of Petkovic and Praljak responded in writing, and today we've received an additional part to that document. From the letter I see that the Trial Chamber has received a copy as well, and I would just like to state clearly for the record -- or, rather, to inform the Trial Chamber for the record that we cannot see any objective reasons. We can see some subjective fears and concerns on the part of the witness but none of them are objective.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Let's move into private session. Registrar, closed session please.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Tuesday, the 18th day of September, 2007, at 2.15 p.m. 22 23 24 25

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 6.56 p.m.,
